headline: Nevish Line Reopens Under Fire; Cape Fight Mounts
war_summary: The Nevish Line, reported closed at the last edition, has reopened. Three actions fell there in the past two hours and four in six, with casualties quickening sharply on both sides — some seven thousand six hundred Colonial and ten thousand Warden dead in the day — though the line still stands eight Colonial, none unclaimed. At Callum's Cape the fighting has concentrated: seven of the day's thirteen actions came inside the last two hours, about Naofa and Scouts Jest, and that sector now reads six Warden and one unclaimed, with a thousand Colonial and eight hundred Warden casualties in two hours. The Weathered Expanse cools by degrees yet remains the busiest ledger in the packet at thirty actions for the day, one in the past two hours; a work recovered there leaves seven Warden and two unclaimed. Marban Hollow has yielded another work to no-man's-land and now stands two Warden, three Colonial, three unclaimed, Checkpoint Bua alone accounting for eighteen actions. Linn Mercy holds ten Colonial and one unclaimed. Mooring County, ten Warden to two Colonial, is the bloodiest quarter of the watch, better than nine thousand Colonial and eight thousand Warden casualties in the day with both rates still rising. Callahan's Passage is quiet at ten Warden.
